title: How to Fix ChatGPT's "Robotic" Results ✍️
description:
ChatGPT's sometimes robotic results is a big reason people don't use it in their job search but it's very easy to fix that. The best way to get better results is just being more specific with the prompt. Specify a clear call to action and tone and you should be getting results that you're looking for. #chatgpt #chatgpt3 #resumetips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
